description: Real Renovate config for renovate-mcp, also kept as a showcase. Edit with this repo's preview_custom_manager (iterate on regex managers) and lint_config (catch Renovate-specific footguns), then dry_run before committing.

packageRules.description: Group all devDependency updates into a single PR to minimise tooling churn.
Auto-merge non-major updates once required CI checks pass. Major bumps still require manual review.

On every renovate devDependency bump, regenerate the committed snapshots under src/data/ so they stay in lockstep with the installed Renovate version. Requires the operator's RENOVATE_ALLOWED_POST_UPGRADE_COMMANDS to permit `npm ci` and the three `npm run generate:*` commands.
